policy.performance: Only reproducible artifact signals are controlled ceilings. Web build bytes and Mobile non-runtime asset bytes must not grow without an explicit reviewed baseline update. The latest Web ceiling increase is the reviewed exact-byte cost of authenticated notification accessibility and release UX hardening. Raw Hermes bytecode size remains diagnostic because repeat builds of unchanged app source showed byte-level variance.
policy.accessibility: Deterministic issue counts are controlled per-route/per-rule ceilings. The public-route baseline remains zero after authenticated-shell hardening; any new deterministic public issue fails.
policy.runtime_timing: Wall-clock timings and encoded transfer bytes remain diagnostic only. Per-route decoded total/JS/CSS resource body bytes are the deterministic release signals enforced separately.
policy.certification_boundary: This baseline is a regression-control artifact. It is not physical-device performance evidence, WCAG certification, store approval or market-release certification.

non_enforced_observations.repeatability_note: Raw Hermes bytecode length and route encoded transfer bytes are retained as diagnostic observations only. Repeated unchanged builds/requests demonstrated byte-level variance, while Web build bytes, Mobile non-runtime assets and decoded route body bytes remained the reproducible signals selected for enforcement.

runtime_resource_budget.policy: Exact-capture decoded total/JS/CSS resource body bytes are controlled per public route. Lower values pass; growth requires an explicit reviewed baseline update. Encoded transfer bytes and wall-clock navigation timings are not budgeted.
